uri.description:
Global unique path for grouping all versioned models.
This field represents the path of the model, not uri. It is not same as {@link ModelRegistry.Entry#uri}.
See {@link ModelRegistry} for definition of path.

numVersions.description: Number of versioned models for this {@link ModelRegistry.Model.MetadataFields#uri}.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Datetime of latest version created for {@link ModelRegistry.Model.MetadataFields#uri}.

lastUpdatedBy.description: Author of latest version for {@link ModelRegistry.Model.MetadataFields#uri}.

title: Holds metadata fields for versioned models corresponding to {@link ModelRegistry.Model.MetadataFields#uri}.
